recognize_zh: 這顆淋巴球核不規則、細胞質很少，但在細胞質下緣可見一顆單獨的圓形紫紅色包涵體，符合 Chediak-Higashi 症候群淋巴球的巨大顆粒。
features: Small-to-intermediate lymphocyte with a scant rim of pale blue cytoplasm
Single round, well-circumscribed reddish-purple cytoplasmic inclusion near the lower cell edge
Irregular, indented nucleus with condensed chromatin
No other abnormal granules in the cytoplasm
Thick area of smear with overlapping red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear, in a thick area with overlapping red cells, shows a lymphocyte with an irregular nucleus and scant pale cytoplasm containing a single, sharply defined, round azurophilic inclusion. The inclusion is larger than the fine granules of normal large granular lymphocytes. Findings are consistent with the giant cytoplasmic granule of Chediak-Higashi syndrome; confirmation by review of neutrophils and genetic testing (LYST) is appropriate.

ddx.vs: LGLs have more abundant cytoplasm with multiple fine azurophilic granules rather than one large inclusion.
An overlying platelet has a granular center with a pale hyalomere and lies outside the focal plane of the cytoplasm.
Alder-Reilly granules are numerous dense granules in all leukocytes rather than a solitary giant granule.
